#!/bin/bash
set -e
DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/models/gemma-3-27b-it"
MISSING=(1 3 6 8 9 10 11)
BASE="https://modelscope.cn/models/google/gemma-3-27b-it/resolve/master"

for i in "${MISSING[@]}"; do
    FNAME=$(printf "model-%05d-of-00012.safetensors" $i)
    FPATH="$DIR/$FNAME"
    
    if [ -f "$FPATH" ] && [ $(stat -c%s "$FPATH") -gt 1000000000 ]; then
        echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] SKIP $FNAME (already exists, size=$(du -h $FPATH | cut -f1))"
        continue
    fi
    
    echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] Downloading $FNAME ..."
    wget -c -q --show-progress -O "$FPATH" "$BASE/$FNAME"
    
    SIZE=$(du -h "$FPATH" | cut -f1)
    echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] DONE $FNAME (size=$SIZE)"
    echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] Disk: $(df -h /root/autodl-tmp | tail -1 | awk '{print $4}') free"
done

echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] ALL SHARDS DOWNLOADED"
BASH
chmod +x /tmp/wget_gemma.sh
echo "Script ready"
tmux kill-session -t gemma_download 2>/dev/null; tmux new -d -s gemma_download 'bash /tmp/wget_gemma.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/wget_gemma.log'
